tree-view.name: Tree View
tree-view.purpose: Display one hierarchical set of nodes with expansion, selection, and keyboard semantics without owning file management, permissions, or admin processs.

anatomy.rule: Owns the visible Tree View container.
Separates selected node state from expanded disclosure state.
Uses symbol, icon, or motion support.

tree-view.statePrecedence: disabled > selected > expanded > focus > hover > default

Energy.decision: Use Flow action as a non-color-only inset/background for selected nodes and action text for expanded disclosure.
Energy.behavior: Tree View exposes local state without absorbing patterns.
Energy.test: Verify selected node includes aria-selected plus action inset/background; expanded uses aria-expanded.
Energy.rejectIf: Selected state is color-only or checkbox tree styling is presented as closed component behavior.

Voice.decision: Use Voice so Tree View remains a bounded component.
Voice.behavior: Tree View exposes local state without absorbing patterns.
Voice.rejectIf: Tree-based editors, permission configuration, drag and drop, and bulk operations belong to patterns.

do: Use Tree View for its bounded job.
dont: Tree-based editors, permission configuration, drag and drop, and bulk operations belong to patterns.
Do not create multi-step system inside it.
Do not rely on color or motion only.
info: Escalate to patterns when orchestration appears.

agentInstructions: Use Tree View only for local component behavior.
Tree-based editors, permission configuration, drag and drop, and bulk operations belong to patterns.
rejectIf: Checkbox tree is presented as a closed component variant without Flow scope decision.
Tree-based editors, permission configuration, drag and drop, and bulk operations belong to patterns.

semanticDecisions.decision: Keep selection and disclosure separate: selected uses aria-selected plus Flow action inset/background; expanded uses aria-expanded and disclosure icon/text.
semanticDecisions.reason: Tree View is a bounded hierarchy component, not route current or a permission editor.
semanticDecisions.test: Verify aria-selected and aria-expanded can change independently.
semanticDecisions.rejectIf: Selection, expansion, and route current are conflated.

semanticDecisions.decision: Checkbox tree is not a closed Tree View variant until Flow scopes it explicitly.
semanticDecisions.reason: Checkbox hierarchies usually imply permissions, bulk selection, or editor rules, which are patterns.
semanticDecisions.test: Verify Tree View docs do not show checkbox variant as complete component behavior.
semanticDecisions.rejectIf: Checkbox tree is documented as a package-backed variant without implementation and scope decision.
